[element-issue-id]
=== `<issue-id>` Issue Identifier (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), used to record an identifier such as a DOI that describes an entire issue of a journal.
